mutations.name: an alpha after the slash is ignored so a clear fill reads as paint
kills: a display-p3 fill paints opaque and at alpha 0.5, and not at alpha 0
an oklch fill with a percentage lightness paints at alpha 0.5, and not at alpha 0

mutations.name: a legacy rgba fill with alpha 0 reads as paint
kills: boxes are the elements that hold text or paint, with decor marked; empty layout wrappers are left out
before the stage fills, only the chrome holds content, and each moment keeps its beat and time
rgb and rgba fills paint unless their alpha is 0
